mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, channel, category, opted_in, updated_at, source FROM notification_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY channel, category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_subscription (user_id, channel, category, opted_in, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{channel}, #{category}, #{optedIn}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'USER')) ON CONFLICT (user_id, channel, category) DO UPDATE SET opted_in = EXCLUDED.opted_in, source = EXCLUDED.source, updated_at = now()
